units.source_en: “Very well.”
units.source_zh: “好吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: In effect, Sakuza was telling Han’emon to go and threaten Ieyasu. People merely laughed off their lord’s amorous escapades and paid them no real heed. Han’emon regarded this as an unspoken understanding among the retainers, but Oni Sakuza cared nothing for it and held fast to his own position. Perhaps doing so would accomplish nothing.

units.source_en: In effect, Sakuza was telling Han’emon to go and threaten Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 作左实际上是让半右卫门去威胁家康。

units.source_en: People merely laughed off their lord’s amorous escapades and paid them no real heed.
units.source_zh: 对于主公的风流韵事，人们不过报之一笑，根本不放在心上。

units.source_en: Han’emon regarded this as an unspoken understanding among the retainers, but Oni Sakuza cared nothing for it and held fast to his own position.
units.source_zh: 半右卫门觉得这是家臣们的默契，但鬼作左却对此不予理会，坚持自己的主张。

units.source_en: Perhaps doing so would accomplish nothing.
units.source_zh: 这样做也许无济于事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作左实际上是让半右卫门去威胁家康。对于主公的风流韵事，人们不过报之一笑，根本不放在心上。半右卫门觉得这是家臣们的默契，但鬼作左却对此不予理会，坚持自己的主张。这样做也许无济于事。

paragraphs.source_en: “She is not with child, is she?” Han’emon quietly asked his wife. His wife nodded, her expression rigid.

units.source_en: “She is not with child, is she?”

ja.t: ごもってはいないのだろう？」

units.source_zh: “她没有身孕吧？”

units.source_en: Han’emon quietly asked his wife.
units.source_zh: 半右卫门悄悄问妻子。

units.source_en: His wife nodded, her expression rigid.
units.source_zh: 妻子表情僵硬地点点头。

paragraphs.source_zh: “她没有身孕吧？”半右卫门悄悄问妻子。妻子表情僵硬地点点头。

paragraphs.source_en: If they claimed that Oman was pregnant, would their lord not realize the truth? How could they keep their lord from seeing through the lie? Han’emon’s mind was so consumed by the difficult demands Lady Tsukiyama might make that he had no attention to spare for anything else. If, as Oni Sakuza had proposed, they said Oman was pregnant, would their lord take her into his private chambers?

units.source_en: If they claimed that Oman was pregnant, would their lord not realize the truth?

ja.t: づかぬはずがあるだろうか。

units.source_zh: 若说阿万怀孕，难道主公会意识不到吗？

units.source_en: How could they keep their lord from seeing through the lie?
units.source_zh: 怎么才能不让主公识破其中的谎言呢？

units.source_en: Han’emon’s mind was so consumed by the difficult demands Lady Tsukiyama might make that he had no attention to spare for anything else.

ja.t: でいっぱいになり、ほかのことなど

units.source_zh: 半右卫门满脑子都是筑山夫人可能提出的难题，根本无暇顾及其他了。

units.source_en: If, as Oni Sakuza had proposed, they said Oman was pregnant, would their lord take her into his private chambers?
units.source_zh: 若如鬼作左所言，称阿万已怀孕，主公会将阿万迎进内室吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 若说阿万怀孕，难道主公会意识不到吗？怎么才能不让主公识破其中的谎言呢？半右卫门满脑子都是筑山夫人可能提出的难题，根本无暇顾及其他了。若如鬼作左所言，称阿万已怀孕，主公会将阿万迎进内室吗？

paragraphs.source_en: “I think I should carry her into the back room and let her rest for a while.” His wife said. Han’emon hastily shook his head. “Wait.”

units.source_en: “I think I should carry her into the back room and let her rest for a while.”
units.source_zh: “我想先把她抱到里屋休息一会儿。”

units.source_en: His wife said.
units.source_zh: 妻子道。

units.source_en: Han’emon hastily shook his head. “Wait.”
units.source_zh: 半右卫门赶紧摇头道：“等一等。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我想先把她抱到里屋休息一会儿。”妻子道。半右卫门赶紧摇头道：“等一等。”

paragraphs.source_en: Han’emon did indeed feel that Ieyasu’s philandering was improper. He even slipped away frequently to the quarters of the maids at Sandō Castle, and in the matter of Oman he had truly gone too far. Yet Ieyasu was still young, after all, and he and Lady Tsukiyama were growing ever more estranged…

units.source_en: Han’emon did indeed feel that Ieyasu’s philandering was improper.
units.source_zh: 家康拈花惹草，半右卫门觉得确实欠妥。

units.source_en: He even slipped away frequently to the quarters of the maids at Sandō Castle, and in the matter of Oman he had truly gone too far.
units.source_zh: 他竟经常偷偷前往三道城侍女的住处，阿万这件事，他也实在太过分了。

units.source_en: Yet Ieyasu was still young, after all, and he and Lady Tsukiyama were growing ever more estranged…
units.source_zh: 但家康毕竟还很年轻，而且，他和筑山夫人也越来越疏远……

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康拈花惹草，半右卫门觉得确实欠妥。他竟经常偷偷前往三道城侍女的住处，阿万这件事，他也实在太过分了。但家康毕竟还很年轻，而且，他和筑山夫人也越来越疏远……

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, I have it!” After his wife carried the half-dead Oman into the back room, Han’emon’s expression suddenly brightened, and he began chuckling like a child. He decided to send Oman to Honda Bungo-no-kami Hirotaka, an elder of the clan.

units.source_en: “Ah, I have it!”
units.source_zh: “哦，有了！”

units.source_en: After his wife carried the half-dead Oman into the back room, Han’emon’s expression suddenly brightened, and he began chuckling like a child.
units.source_zh: 妻子将半死不活的阿万抱到里屋后，半右卫门的表情突然舒展开来，像个孩子般呵呵笑了起来。

units.source_en: He decided to send Oman to Honda Bungo-no-kami Hirotaka, an elder of the clan.
units.source_zh: 他决定将阿万送到家族的长者本多丰后守广孝处去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦，有了！”妻子将半死不活的阿万抱到里屋后，半右卫门的表情突然舒展开来，像个孩子般呵呵笑了起来。他决定将阿万送到家族的长者本多丰后守广孝处去。

paragraphs.source_en: Han’emon told his wife to retire first, then quietly closed the door and pondered the matter over and over. Sakuza truly was a remarkable man. Had it not been for him, Oman would probably have been killed already.

units.source_en: Han’emon told his wife to retire first, then quietly closed the door and pondered the matter over and over.
units.source_zh: 半右卫门令妻子先去歇息，自己悄悄闭上门，反复琢磨此事。

units.source_en: Sakuza truly was a remarkable man.
units.source_zh: 作左的确是个了不起的男子。

units.source_en: Had it not been for him, Oman would probably have been killed already.

ja.t: されていたことだろう。

units.source_zh: 倘若没有他，阿万恐已经被杀了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 半右卫门令妻子先去歇息，自己悄悄闭上门，反复琢磨此事。作左的确是个了不起的男子。倘若没有他，阿万恐已经被杀了。
